title: Diagnosing bugs
img: A mechanic in a workshop studies and works on a motorcycle engine.
extra: Teach redact first, the tight feedback loop (red-capable, deterministic, fast, agent-runnable) and its ways, the phase gates (reproduce/minimise, 3–5 ranked falsifiable hypotheses, instrument with tagged logs, fix + regression test at a correct seam or record the missing seam, cleanup), then `/retro`. Site story: the author never invoked the Skill in v1; keep the symptom → diagnosis → fix incidents honestly as everyday debugging. The real unfixed `/learn/nope` returns 200 bug is a good exercise.
